weapons.name: Photon Singularity Beam
weapons.description: Collapsed-light lance; accurate heavy damage that cuts shields and armor alike.

weapons.name: Quantum Entanglement Torpedo
weapons.description: Slow phased warhead; often misses and shields blunt it, but it punches through armor.

weapons.name: Neutron Beam
weapons.description: Reliable general-purpose beam fitted to civilian hulls.

weapons.name: Graviton Pulse
weapons.description: Rapid gravity waves; strong against shields, weak against armor.

weapons.name: Magnetic Resonance Disruptor
weapons.description: Shield breaker; little hull damage. Later slices may add system disruption.
